tagline.en: A simulator-driven world for multi-agent and embodied policy rollouts.
tagline.zh: 一个由模拟器驱动的世界,用于多智能体与具身策略 rollout。

en: SimWorld is a world-model environment built around a controllable simulator. Rather than generating video, it provides an interactive world you can drive with actions, supporting multi-agent simulation and embodied policy rollouts.

In WorldFoundry the SimWorld route is registered. Because it runs against a simulator server and its assets, you stage those first; then you can control the simulator and roll out embodied policies through the pipeline.
zh: SimWorld 是一个围绕可控模拟器构建的世界模型环境。它不生成视频,而是提供一个可以用动作驱动的交互世界,支持多智能体模拟与具身策略 rollout。
在 WorldFoundry 中已注册 SimWorld 路由。由于它需要对接模拟器服务与其资源,你需先准备好这些;之后即可通过 pipeline 控制模拟器并执行具身策略 rollout。

whenToUse.en: When you need an interactive simulator to run multi-agent scenarios or roll out embodied policies, rather than to generate video.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个交互式模拟器来运行多智能体场景或执行具身策略 rollout,而不是生成视频时。

notFor.en: Not a video or image generator. It needs a running simulator server and its assets staged before it can run.
notFor.zh: 它不是视频或图像生成器。运行前需先启动模拟器服务并准备好其资源。

en: Supports multi-agent simulation and embodied rollouts
Runs against a simulator server plus its assets
zh: 由模拟器驱动的交互式世界模型
支持多智能体模拟与具身 rollout
对接模拟器服务及其资源运行
